description: V0.2 attribute-level evidence grounding (spec §18/§19). Only a bounded set of material product attributes is grounded; anything outside this set is NOT_CHECKABLE and never counts as SUPPORTED. Every search term lives here, never in code.
required_note: Only `coverage_type` is REQUIRED, because it is the one attribute the demo knowledge base actually speaks to for every product family. The other attributes are grounded and reported but must NOT block: the demo KB carries no per-product renewal/term/deductible wording, so blocking on them would reject every product and teach nothing. A required attribute that the evidence does not state IS a positive UNSUPPORTED and DOES block.

policy_doc.design_rationale: V0.2 uses a 'core-attribute hard-block + auxiliary-attribute non-blocking' strategy. Only `coverage_type` is REQUIRED (blocking) because it is the single attribute the demo knowledge base actually speaks to for every product family. The auxiliary attributes (eligibility_age, renewal_period, deductible, coverage_term) ARE grounded and reported for transparency, but they MUST NOT block a product: the demo KB carries no per-product renewal/term/deductible wording, so blocking on them would reject every product and teach nothing.
policy_doc.important_caveat: Non-blocking does NOT mean the evidence has PROVEN the attribute. A non-blocking attribute whose evidence is insufficient remains exposed as UNSUPPORTED / NOT_CHECKABLE (uncertainty) and is surfaced as a non-blocking mismatch — it must never be silently read as SUPPORTED. Only a positive UNSUPPORTED (evidence exists and contradicts the claim) downgrades a product; NOT_CHECKABLE never blocks on its own.
